shared_elements: low-relief carving on weathered grey stone
justification: Both surfaces organise shallow, schematic relief into horizontal registers combining plain discs, repeated triangular/pendant elements and a chevron or zigzag band, and both include a crudely rendered anthropomorphic form. However, A is a three-dimensional, heavily eroded freestanding block shaped as a head-and-body whose ornament wraps a curved volume, while B is a flat framed panel with crisper, more linear and evenly ruled geometric ornament, so the correspondences are generic rather than compositional.
